title: A Bit of Relief: Rick Steves' Travel Dreams

sentences.en: We are recording.
sentences.zh: 我们在录音了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Hi, Rick.
sentences.zh: 嗨，里克。

sentences.en: Sam, nice to see you.
sentences.zh: 萨姆，很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Rick Steves, one of my favorite people on the planet.
sentences.zh: 里克·斯蒂夫斯，我星球上最喜欢的人之一。

sentences.en: Sam, nice to hear from you again.
sentences.zh: 萨姆，很高兴再次听到你的消息。

sentences.en: We had a good conversation a while ago, and now it's a whole different world.
sentences.zh: 不久前我们聊得很开心，现在却成了完全不同的世界。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I profiled you.
sentences.zh: 是啊，所以我为你写了人物特写。

sentences.en: My profile of you came out in the New York Times Magazine last year.
sentences.zh: 我写你的特写去年发表在《纽约时报杂志》上。

sentences.en: And part of the reason I wanted to call and talk to you was you and I are supposed to be hanging out.
sentences.zh: 我想打电话和你聊聊的部分原因是我们本该聚一聚的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没，错。

sentences.en: It was one of the last things I deleted from my calendar.
sentences.zh: 这是我从日历上删掉的最后几件事之一。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Anderson, and I'm a staff writer for the New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·安德森，《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: And last year, I wrote a profile of the travel guru Rick Steves.
sentences.zh: 去年，我写了一篇关于旅游大师里克·斯蒂夫斯的特写。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Rick Steves.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是里克·斯蒂夫斯。

sentences.en: For many travelers, the quintessence of Spain is found here, Andalusia.
sentences.zh: 对许多游客来说，西班牙的精髓就在这里，安达卢西亚。

sentences.en: So Rick Steves, for anyone who doesn't know, he's really an evangelist of travel.
sentences.zh: 里克·斯蒂夫斯，对任何不了解的人来说，他真的是一位旅行的传道者。

sentences.en: Today, like Turkey in general, Gazeljord is Muslim.
sentences.zh: 今天，就像整个土耳其一样，加泽尔约德是穆斯林。

sentences.en: The power of Rick Steves is that this is not just a business for him.
sentences.zh: 里克·斯蒂夫斯的魅力在于，对她而言这不仅仅是一桩生意。

sentences.en: It's a whole life philosophy.
sentences.zh: 这是一种完整的人生哲学。

sentences.en: Acabit.
sentences.zh: 生命之水。

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: It means the water of life.
sentences.zh: 意思是生命之水。

sentences.en: And it tastes like that when it goes for the herring.
sentences.zh: 当它用来配鲱鱼时，就是那个味道。

sentences.en: Okay, well, this is the learner's dose here, but I'll give it a go.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这只是初学者的剂量，但我会试试。

sentences.en: He wants to empower average, everyday Americans who might not otherwise leave the country to get out of their comfort zone and go explore the world.
sentences.zh: 他希望赋予那些平时可能不会离开国门的普通美国人力量，让他们走出舒适区，去探索世界。

sentences.en: They give an insight into a people who, in a thousand years, have evolved from fearsome, marauding Vikings to people like me.
sentences.zh: 它们让我们深入了解这样一群人：在一千年里，他们从可怕的掠夺性维京人演变成像我这样的人。

sentences.en: And I've been thinking about him a lot since we've all been hunkered down because here's a guy who's in constant motion.
sentences.zh: 自从我们都宅在家里以来，我一直在想他，因为这家伙总是在不停地运动。

sentences.en: He just thrives on moving from one place to the next.
sentences.zh: 他就是在从一个地方搬到另一个地方的过程中茁壮成长。

sentences.en: He's always traveling.
sentences.zh: 他总是在旅行。

sentences.en: And suddenly, the entire world is shut down.
sentences.zh: 突然间，整个世界都关门了。

sentences.en: It's like a switch was flipped and his whole life mission is just canceled.
sentences.zh: 就像有人按下了开关，他毕生的使命就这样被取消了。

sentences.en: All these dreams that have been dashed are actually put on hold.
sentences.zh: 所有这些破灭的梦想其实都被搁置了。

sentences.en: So I was wondering, what does Rick Steves do with his time?
sentences.zh: 所以我在想，里克·斯蒂夫斯都在做些什么？

sentences.en: And maybe an even bigger question, if Rick Steves can't travel, then who is Rick Steves?
sentences.zh: 也许还有一个更大的问题：如果里克·斯蒂夫斯不能旅行了，那么里克·斯蒂夫斯是谁？

sentences.en: There was nothing on my calendar.
sentences.zh: 我的日程表上什么也没有。

sentences.en: It was just a complete blank slate for my future.
sentences.zh: 我的未来完全是一张白纸。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So what have you been doing day by day instead of hanging around with me?
sentences.zh: 那么，除了跟我闲逛之外，你每天都在做些什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, the big part of my life is a part that was always squeezed away by my workaholism.
sentences.zh: 我生活中的很大一部分，以前总是被我的工作狂挤压掉。

sentences.en: And that's just enjoying being alive in this privileged little world.
sentences.zh: 那就是享受在这个优越的小世界里活着的乐趣。

sentences.en: I've got a nice place in Edmonds, half hour north of Seattle.
sentences.zh: 我在埃德蒙兹有个不错的地方，在西雅图以北半小时车程。

sentences.en: I've got a view of the mountains.
sentences.zh: 我能看到山景。

sentences.en: It seems like the volume of the birds have been cranked up.
sentences.zh: 感觉鸟儿的音量被调大了。

sentences.en: When I step out of the morning, there's less traffic and more bird sound.
sentences.zh: 早晨我走出去时，交通减少了，鸟叫声变多了。

sentences.en: And I've been thinking about dusting off old passions.
sentences.zh: 我一直在考虑重新拾起旧日的热情。

sentences.en: I got out my trumpet and the valves hadn't wiggled for literally decades.
sentences.zh: 我拿出了我的小号，那些活塞 literalmente 几十年都没动过了。

sentences.en: And I could still play the trumpet, which is fun.
sentences.zh: 我居然还会吹小号，这很有趣。

sentences.en: I didn't even know you played the trumpet.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道你会吹小号。

sentences.en: I thought I knew everything about you.
sentences.zh: 我还以为我对你了如指掌呢。

sentences.en: I'd like to keep a few things to pull out later.
sentences.zh: 我想留着一些东西以后再拿出来。

sentences.en: What other elements of life have you been finding yourself enjoying?
sentences.zh: 你发现自己还在享受生活的哪些其他元素？

sentences.en: I mean, it sounds ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这听起来很荒谬。

sentences.en: But I have never cooked, Sam, in my whole life.
sentences.zh: 但萨姆，我这辈子从来没做过饭。

sentences.en: I have never cut into an onion in my entire life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子从来没切过洋葱。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: I had never really made pasta until now.
sentences.zh: 我直到现在才真正做过意面。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: I've had a bad attitude about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此一直抱有不好的态度。

sentences.en: I've always, you know, I've been at parties.
sentences.zh: 我总是，你知道的，我参加过派对。

sentences.en: And people put on a, what do you call it, a bib?
sentences.zh: 人们戴上那个，你叫它什么来着，围嘴？

sentences.en: Or what was that?
sentences.zh: 或者那是什么？

sentences.en: Apron?
sentences.zh: 围裙？

sentences.en: An apron, yeah.
sentences.zh: 围裙，对。

sentences.en: Apron, yeah.
sentences.zh: 围裙，对。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's called an apron.
sentences.zh: 对，那叫围裙。

sentences.en: They put it on an apron and everybody's having a good time, convivial, slicing, you know, mushrooms in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 他们系上围裙，每个人都玩得很开心，很融洽，在厨房里切着蘑菇。

sentences.en: And I just was awkward.
sentences.zh: 而我只会觉得尴尬。

sentences.en: And I would just go to the living room and I'd sit there alone with my chips and dip, you know.
sentences.zh: 我只会去客厅，一个人坐在那里吃着薯片和蘸酱，你知道的。

sentences.en: And now I'm realizing what I've missed.
sentences.zh: 现在我才意识到我错过了什么。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And it's like somebody just told me there's a whole new world out there.
sentences.zh: 就像有人告诉我外面有一个全新的世界。

sentences.en: You can do something more than go out to eat, bring home, you know, leftovers and make picnics.
sentences.zh: 你可以做的不仅仅是出去吃饭、打包剩菜，然后去野餐。

sentences.en: So, I mean, that's just a delight.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，这真是一种享受。

sentences.en: So, you're really expanding your horizons.
sentences.zh: 所以你真的在拓宽视野。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, you know, I'm learning to travel without any airplane tickets.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你知道的，我正在学习不用机票就能旅行。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: This is a huge change.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的改变。

sentences.en: It's a great thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件好事。

sentences.en: It's, you know, but I have to be mindful that I'm really privileged and I hope that, you know, when people think about this,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，但我必须记住我真的很幸运，我希望，你知道的，当人们想到这一点时，

sentences.en: they think about it mindful of the fact that it hits a lot of people who don't have the ability to weather it as well as we do pretty brutally.
sentences.zh: 他们会考虑到这样一个事实：它对许多没有我们这样应对能力的人打击相当残酷。

sentences.en: But one way or another, we'll get through this.
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，我们会挺过这一关的。

sentences.en: I guess one of my big hopes, Sam, is that social distancing doesn't become the norm.
sentences.zh: 萨姆，我想我的一个大愿望是社交距离不要成为常态。

sentences.en: I just love the way the French kiss each other on the cheek.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢法国人互相行贴面礼了。

sentences.en: I love a nice high five when I get to the top of a little peak in Switzerland.
sentences.zh: 当我登顶瑞士的小山峰时，我喜欢来一个漂亮的击掌。

sentences.en: And you want to sit next to a stranger and share your French fries in an English pub.
sentences.zh: 你想和一个陌生人坐在一起，在英国酒吧里分享你的炸薯条。

sentences.en: I think one of the great pleasures that you provide people all the time is the fun of traveling vicariously.
sentences.zh: 我认为你一直带给人们的巨大乐趣之一就是神游旅行的乐趣。

sentences.en: And I remember people telling me that you often get letters from prisoners saying that even in prison, people watch your show and feel like they're out in the world.
sentences.zh: 我记得有人告诉我，你经常收到囚犯的来信，说即使在监狱里，人们看你的节目也会觉得自己置身于外面的世界。

sentences.en: And so, I wonder if that aspect of your teaching is even more powerful now, if you've heard anything from people about that.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想知道你的这种教学方式现在是不是更有力量了，你有没有听到人们对此的反馈。

sentences.en: I actually have, because one of my themes lately is this virus can stop our travel plans, but it cannot stop our travel dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 我确实听到了，因为我最近的主题之一就是这个病毒可以阻止我们的旅行计划，但它无法阻止我们的旅行梦想。

sentences.en: We're not in business to make money right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在做生意不是为了赚钱。

sentences.en: Our mission is to keep people's travel dreams alive and to give people something positive.
sentences.zh: 我们的使命是让人们的旅行梦想保持活力，并给人们带来积极的东西。

sentences.en: We just, a couple days ago, designed Rick Steves' Europe Bingo, where the cards have all of the little goofy cliches that show up in almost every one of my shows.
sentences.zh: 就在几天前，我们设计了“里克·斯蒂夫斯欧洲宾果游戏”，卡片上有几乎在我每个节目中都会出现的那些傻乎乎的陈词滥调。

sentences.en: And we've made that available.
sentences.zh: 我们已经把它发布出去了。

sentences.en: And people can, you can turn it into a drinking game if you want, but it's just a...
sentences.zh: 人们可以，如果你愿意的话可以把它变成饮酒游戏，但它只是一个……

sentences.en: Okay, hold on, wait.
sentences.zh: 好吧，等等，等一下。

sentences.en: What are the key triggers in the Rick Steves' travel drinking game?
sentences.zh: 里克·斯蒂夫斯旅行饮酒游戏的关键触发点是什么？

sentences.en: Oh, well, it's a bingo board, so you've got all of your, if I use alliteration.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧，这是一块宾果游戏板，所以你拥有了所有的，如果我用了头韵。

sentences.en: The interior both stirs the soul and stokes the appetite.
sentences.zh: 内部既触动心灵又激发食欲。

sentences.en: Or if I have a thinly-veiled guidebook plug.
sentences.zh: 或者如果我有一个掩饰不住的旅游指南广告植入。

sentences.en: I've been recommending the Cascadale Farm in my Britain guidebook now for over 20 years.
sentences.zh: 我在我的英国旅游指南里推荐卡斯卡代尔农场已经超过20年了。

sentences.en: Or a dorky joke, or if I use the word evocative or convivial, I like to use that a lot.
sentences.zh: 或者一个傻气的笑话，或者如果我用了“迷人”或“融洽”这个词，我非常喜欢用这个。

sentences.en: You'll enjoy a convivial camaraderie.
sentences.zh: 你会享受融洽的友情。

sentences.en: This is the convivial, Cataluña, charming conviviality.
sentences.zh: 这是融洽的加泰罗尼亚，迷人的融洽感。

sentences.en: Um, if I enjoy a drink locally.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果我在当地喝上一杯。

sentences.en: Oh, boy, here comes another wine change.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，又一款葡萄酒要上场了。

sentences.en: This is the Vincanto.
sentences.zh: 这是温坎托葡萄酒。

sentences.en: If I say, oh, baby.
sentences.zh: 如果我说，哦，宝贝。

sentences.en: Oh, baby.
sentences.zh: 哦，宝贝。

sentences.en: It's a great way to decompress that.
sentences.zh: 这是减压的好方法。

sentences.en: If I have innuendo.
sentences.zh: 如果我有双关语。

sentences.en: Towering high above is a skyscraper built in the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 高高耸立的是一座建于20世纪70年代的摩天大楼。

sentences.en: An erection like this was a big deal in communist times.
sentences.zh: 像这样的雄伟建筑在共产主义时期可是件大事。

sentences.en: You know, I can't say anything explicit, but I can have plenty of innuendo.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不能说任何露骨的话，但我可以有很多双关语。

sentences.en: The lady strokes the unicorn's horn, and the lion looks out at us to be sure we get the double on top.
sentences.zh: 女士抚摸着独角兽的角，狮子看着我们，确保我们捕捉到了顶部的双关含义。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: You know, that's kind of what I do in almost every show.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这基本上就是我几乎在每个节目里都在做的事情。

sentences.en: So you can certainly get bingo if you watch the show.
sentences.zh: 所以你看节目的话肯定能中宾果。

sentences.en: And keep on traveling.
sentences.zh: 继续旅行吧。

sentences.en: Ciao.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: I'm developing this notion that you can play a little game of bringing Europe into your home.
sentences.zh: 我正在形成这样一个概念：你可以玩一个小游戏，把欧洲带进你的家。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: Which might be kind of fun.
sentences.zh: 这可能会挺有趣的。

sentences.en: Maybe it's not.
sentences.zh: 也许并非如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 是的，跟我讲讲这个。

sentences.en: Well, people who are addicted to European travel, this is kind of a frustrating time for them.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那些对欧洲旅行上瘾的人，这段时间对他们来说有点令人沮丧。

sentences.en: So I've been thinking about a few ways that you can bring a little bit of Europe into your home.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在想几种方法，可以把一点欧洲风情带进你的家里。

sentences.en: And I don't know how workable it is for everybody, but, you know, you can wash your socks in the sink.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这对每个人来说有多可行，但是，你知道，你可以在水槽里洗袜子。

sentences.en: You can actually serve coffee to your quarantine mates in tiny cups and charge for refills.
sentences.zh: 你实际上可以用小杯子给你的隔离伙伴提供咖啡，并为续杯收费。

sentences.en: When you get real desperate, you can eat a slug with lots of garlic and call it escargot.
sentences.zh: 当你绝望的时候，你可以吃一只放大蒜的鼻涕虫并称之为法式蜗牛。

sentences.en: And I actually made a little table with a dish for coins outside of the toilet in my house.
sentences.zh: 我实际上在我家马桶外面做了一个小桌子，上面放着一个放硬币的盘子。

sentences.en: And you can charge family members for a few sheets of toilet paper.
sentences.zh: 你可以向家庭成员收取几张卫生纸的费用。

sentences.en: If you're desperate for Europe.
sentences.zh: 如果你极度渴望欧洲的话。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: Always an entrepreneur, even in your own home.
sentences.zh: 不愧是企业家，即使在自己家里也是如此。

sentences.en: So I make Europe my beat.
sentences.zh: 所以我把欧洲作为我的报道领域。

sentences.en: That's all I do.
sentences.zh: 我只做这个。

sentences.en: For me, Europe is the wading pool for world exploration, even though my favorite country might be India.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，欧洲是世界探索的浅水池，尽管我最喜欢的国家可能是印度。

sentences.en: I didn't know that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这一点。

sentences.en: Your favorite country is India?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢的国家是印度？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Oh, I love India.
sentences.zh: 哦，我爱印度。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: When did you first go to India?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候第一次去印度的？

sentences.en: I've been to India.
sentences.zh: 我去过印度。

sentences.en: My best trip was in 78, after I graduated from college.
sentences.zh: 我最好的一次旅行是在78年，我大学毕业后。

sentences.en: These are from the days of those great photos of you with the long hair and the beard.
sentences.zh: 这些是你留着长发和大胡子的那些精彩照片时期的。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: I was the classic hippie traveler.
sentences.zh: 我是典型的嬉皮士旅行者。

sentences.en: And, I mean, the first time I ever smoked marijuana was in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我第一次抽大麻是在阿富汗。

sentences.en: I knew that, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我知道，是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I think that one of the happiest days of my life was hanging out in Kathmandu with a bunch of people who didn't have to climb a mountain to get high, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得我人生中最快乐的日子之一，就是在加德满都和一群不用靠爬山来寻求亢奋的人一起闲逛，你知道的。

sentences.en: Yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: To you, the straight-laced, repressed Protestant kid.
sentences.zh: 对于你这个死板、压抑的新教徒孩子来说。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, you know, they were selling marijuana in the market as a medicinal herb, and it just seemed quite natural there.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，他们当时在市场上把大麻当成草药卖，在那里感觉再自然不过了。

sentences.en: So I thought, okay, I'll be like, do as the locals do.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，好吧，我要入乡随俗。

sentences.en: I'll be a temporary local.
sentences.zh: 我要当一个短暂的当地人。

sentences.en: There's a place in Kathmandu called Pie and Chai.
sentences.zh: 加德满都有个地方叫Pie and Chai。

sentences.en: And they were famous with all the travelers for their fresh out-of-the-oven apple pie in the Himalayas.
sentences.zh: 他们以喜马拉雅山刚出炉的新鲜苹果派闻名于所有旅行者。

sentences.en: And you'd be surrounded by all this Nepalese wonder.
sentences.zh: 然后你会置身于所有这些尼泊尔的奇观之中。

sentences.en: And people that clasp their hands together and say, namaste, I salute your virtues.
sentences.zh: 还有那些双手合十说“纳玛斯代，我向你的美德致敬”的人们。

sentences.en: Feels like a Tibetan dream, you know.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是一个西藏式的梦境，你知道的。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: And I just thought, life is so good.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得，生活太美好了。

sentences.en: And that was, I mean, I hate to say, one of the happiest days of my life, and I must have been smoking pot in the same breath, but, you know, it was a beautiful thing.
sentences.zh: 那真的是——虽然我不想这么说——我人生中最快乐的日子之一，而且我当时肯定一边抽着大麻一边有这种感觉，但，你知道，那是一种美好的体验。

sentences.en: Yeah, and you became a real powerhouse in that battle for legalization in Washington, your home state,
sentences.zh: 对，后来你在华盛顿州——也就是你的家乡——那场争取大麻合法化的战斗中成了真正的大佬，

sentences.en: and then traveled around to other states on these kind of barnstorming tours to get it legalized.
sentences.zh: 然后又去其他州进行了这种巡回宣传活动，推动合法化。

sentences.en: And that's my big, I see that as a contribution to our democracy and our society.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我的一大贡献，我把它看作是对我们民主和社会的贡献。

sentences.en: Not that it's pro-marijuana, but it's pro-civil liberties.
sentences.zh: 倒不是说这支持大麻，而是支持公民自由。

sentences.en: You know, I'm a traveler, and for me, high is a place.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我是一个旅行者，对我来说，“嗨”是一种境界。

sentences.en: And sometimes I want to go there.
sentences.zh: 有时我想去那里。

sentences.en: One of my favorite things that I learned about you when I was at your house was the existence of this journal that you've been keeping for most of your life now,
sentences.zh: 我在你家做客时，了解到关于你的一件最喜欢的事情，就是你大半生一直在写的一本日志的存在，

sentences.en: and you write in it only when you're high.
sentences.zh: 而且你只有在“嗨”的时候才会在里面写东西。

sentences.en: That, not many people know about that until you wrote about that in our article in the New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 这件事没多少人知道，直到你在我们《纽约时报杂志》的文章里写到它。

sentences.en: And that book is a, yeah, that's a treasure.
sentences.zh: 那本书是一个——对，那是个宝藏。

sentences.en: And someday, well, I'm going to continue adding to it, but it is, it's 40, what is it?
sentences.zh: 而且总有一天，好吧，我会继续往里面写，但它是，它已经40年了，是什么来着？

sentences.en: It's probably 40 years.
sentences.zh: 可能已经40年了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Of brilliance that came to me.
sentences.zh: 那是降临到我身上的才华。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: Actually, this is what I do when I'm traveling anyways, is I always have a little Moleskine book, a little notepad in my pocket, and you grab whatever flutters by.
sentences.zh: 其实，我无论如何旅行都是这样，我的口袋里总会带着一本小Moleskine笔记本，随手抓取任何飘过的心思。

sentences.en: It's like butterflies.
sentences.zh: 就像蝴蝶一样。

sentences.en: If you don't grab it, it's gone forever.
sentences.zh: 如果你不抓住它，它就永远消失了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Would you read a couple of them?
sentences.zh: 你能读几段吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Getting high releases the human in me.
sentences.zh: 嗨起来释放了我体内的凡人属性。

sentences.en: A baby doesn't know if the hanging is on the wall or if the wall is on the hanging.
sentences.zh: 婴儿并不知道壁挂是在墙上，还是墙在壁挂上。

sentences.en: Here's an idea.
sentences.zh: 有个想法。

sentences.en: Make a rug with vacuum marks so it always looks freshly vacuumed.
sentences.zh: 做一个带有吸尘器印记的地毯，这样它看起来总是刚吸过尘一样。

sentences.en: That's a good one.
sentences.zh: 这个不错。

sentences.en: I've been craning my mind to see you.
sentences.zh: 我一直在伸长心智去见你。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I love using a word in a little different environment.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在稍微不同的环境里使用一个词。

sentences.en: Craning my mind, why not?
sentences.zh: 伸长心智，为什么不呢？

sentences.en: As soon as I stop mattering so much, I'll be happier.
sentences.zh: 一旦我不再那么在乎自我，我就会更快乐。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: That one's deep.
sentences.zh: 那句很有深度。

sentences.en: Getting high is like roasting an English muffin.
sentences.zh: 嗨起来就像烤英式玛芬。

sentences.en: You start out cold and doughy, and you toast it to a crisp brown, and just a little more, and you get all black and burned.
sentences.zh: 你一开始冷冰冰湿乎乎的，然后把它烤成金黄酥脆，再多烤一会儿，就会全变黑烧焦了。

sentences.en: Love it.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Love it.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I feel like a hungry bird, but I won't eat any worm I don't like.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己像一只饥饿的鸟，但我绝不吃任何我不喜欢的虫子。

sentences.en: It's funny.
sentences.zh: 真搞笑。

sentences.en: No, it's just, that's intense.
sentences.zh: 不，只是，这太强烈了。

sentences.en: And then, at the very end, I said, when I die, scatter me all over the budget hotels of Europe.
sentences.zh: 然后，在最后，我说，当我死后，把我撒遍欧洲的经济型酒店。

sentences.en: Love it.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: I guess this is a precious thing, because it's me.
sentences.zh: 我想这是一件珍贵的东西，因为这就是我。

sentences.en: Okay, one last thing.
sentences.zh: 好吧，最后一件事情。

sentences.en: As a favor to everyone stuck at home right now, I'm wondering if you can transport us for just a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 作为对现在所有被困在家里的每个人的一点心意，我想知道你能不能带我们去旅行几分钟。

sentences.en: Can you bring us to one particular place in Europe and guide us through a perfect meal?
sentences.zh: 你能带我们去欧洲的某个特定地方，并带我们享用一顿完美的餐食吗？

sentences.en: I love that idea.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个主意。

sentences.en: Oh, I could be anywhere in Europe.
sentences.zh: 哦，我在欧洲哪里都可以。

sentences.en: When you have that coincidence of this perfect storm of ambiance and local ingredients and an appetite and good company.
sentences.zh: 当你拥有这种巧合——氛围、当地食材、食欲和好陪伴的完美风暴时。

sentences.en: Let me take you to a farm in Tuscany.
sentences.zh: 我带你们去托斯卡纳的一个农场吧。

sentences.en: I'm sitting at this polished, hardwood dinner table, surrounded by murky portraits of ancestors, of the family that's sitting at the table with me.
sentences.zh: 我正坐在光洁的硬木餐桌旁，周围是昏暗的祖先画像，他们是和我同桌的家族成员。

sentences.en: And everything at that table was produced on the farm.
sentences.zh: 桌上的所有东西都是农场自己生产的。

sentences.en: And you were there, walking through the fields, you know, petting the sheep, hearing the squeal of the pigs being butchered.
sentences.zh: 而你就坐在那里，走在田野里，你知道的，抚摸着绵羊，听着被宰杀的猪发出的尖叫声。

sentences.en: You were there that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那天下午你就在那里。

sentences.en: And now, people with calloused hands have joined you at the table.
sentences.zh: 现在，历经风霜双手的乡亲们也加入了你们的饭桌。

sentences.en: The little kids, learning how to roll spaghetti with their forks, are there at the table.
sentences.zh: 那些正在学习用叉子卷意大利面的小孩子们也坐在桌旁。

sentences.en: The grandma, who doesn't walk very well anymore but still joins the family at the table.
sentences.zh: 那位走路已经不太利索但依然加入家族聚餐的祖母。

sentences.en: She's there, looking with pride.
sentences.zh: 她也在那里，带着骄傲的目光看着。

sentences.en: And the man of the house picks up the wine.
sentences.zh: 一家之主拿起了酒。

sentences.en: And the family name is on the wine.
sentences.zh: 酒瓶上印着家族的姓氏。

sentences.en: And he pours that wine.
sentences.zh: 他倒了那杯酒。

sentences.en: And he's sort of gripped the bottle so that I can see the family name on the label.
sentences.zh: 他握着酒瓶的姿势正好能让我看到标签上的家族姓氏。

sentences.en: And then we have the prosciutto.
sentences.zh: 然后我们有了意式生火腿。

sentences.en: We have the cheese.
sentences.zh: 我们有了奶酪。

sentences.en: We have the bread.
sentences.zh: 我们有了面包。

sentences.en: So you've got that conviviality.
sentences.zh: 所以你感受到了那种欢乐融融的氛围。

sentences.en: You've got that heritage.
sentences.zh: 你感受到了那种传承。

sentences.en: You've got that terroir.
sentences.zh: 你感受到了那种风土。

sentences.en: You've got the sweat of generations that's fertilized to that land.
sentences.zh: 你感受到了滋养这片土地的几代人的汗水。

sentences.en: You've got your pasta.
sentences.zh: 你的意大利面端上来了。

sentences.en: You've got your meat course coming.
sentences.zh: 你的肉类主菜也要来了。

sentences.en: And I'm sure you've got a dessert later.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定待会儿还有甜点。

sentences.en: But right now, it's just that very, very elemental bread, cheese, beautiful prosciutto.
sentences.zh: 但现在，只有那些最基础的面包、奶酪和美味的火腿。

sentences.en: Corpozo, that means full-bodied red wine.
sentences.zh: Corpozo，这意味着酒体饱满的红葡萄酒。

sentences.en: And the pride of that family.
sentences.zh: 还有这个家族的骄傲。

sentences.en: That's a moment.
sentences.zh: 这就是一个完美的时刻。

sentences.en: That's a good, good me.
sentences.zh: 这是一段非常非常美好的经历。

sentences.en: And that's why I can hardly wait for this crisis to get over and we can get back together and celebrate not only that kind of culture,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我迫不及待地想要这场危机过去，这样我们就能重新聚在一起，不仅是为了庆祝那种文化，

sentences.en: but sharing that kind of culture from their hemisphere to ours.
sentences.zh: 更是为了将这种文化从他们的半球分享到我们的半球。

sentences.en: Spectacular.
sentences.zh: 太精彩了。

sentences.en: That was a fun thing to think about there.
sentences.zh: 思考这些事情真是一件有趣的事。

sentences.en: And I think that can help inspire people to let their dreams take them away.
sentences.zh: 我想这能帮助激发人们让梦想带他们远行。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much, Rick.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，里克。

sentences.en: This felt almost as fun as hanging out in your living room and looking out at Puget Sound and maybe even sharing a toke of a dube with you.
sentences.zh: 感觉这几乎和坐在你起居室里、看着普吉特海湾、甚至可能和你一起抽一口雪茄一样有趣。

sentences.en: Sam, you're great.
sentences.zh: 萨姆，你太棒了。

sentences.en: Rick, you're the beSt.
sentences.zh: 里克，你才是最棒的。

sentences.en: Man, oh man, that was fun.
sentences.zh: 天哪，天哪，这太有趣了。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们将为您准备假期招待客人的攻略。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一觉睡到天黑的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会失去知觉去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们爱喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用或您喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: But even though that's right.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此也是对的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'll hand it.
sentences.zh: 我这就交给你了。
